collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DISABILITY AND HUMAN DIVERSITY (DIV-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Disabled villagers, chronic illness and every kind of body, skin, hair and face: wheelchairs with real wheels, crutches, canes, ear trumpets, signs and lenses made from island materials; good days and hard days; competence, humor and opinions. Sometimes the difference is the story. Often it's just part of the scenery.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult and a cook or another adult; in the story (name1) has a serious allergy to one kind of nut)

collection.description: A villager with a dangerous nut allergy asks what is in the feast stew and is waved off: ask exactly, or skip the stew.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has a serious allergy: if (subject.he/she) eats even a little of one particular kind of nut, (subject.his/her) throat swells and (subject.he/she) can't breathe, and it's very dangerous. Tonight there's a feast, and (friend), who is cooking, has made a gorgeous stew. When (subject) asks what's in it, (friend) waves a hand. "Oh, a bit of everything. Try it!"

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) asks again, firmly. (friend), a little offended, lists everything. And there it is: a handful of the nuts, crushed into the sauce for richness. (friend) goes pale. (subject) eats the fish and the roots instead. At the next feast, (friend) cooks a separate pot with no nuts at all, and puts a white shell on the lid so (subject) knows which. (subject) eats three bowls.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) doesn't want an argument and just doesn't eat the stew. (friend) notices and is hurt. Later, (subject) explains. (friend) is quiet for a long moment. "You could have died," (friend.he/she) says. "Yes," says (subject). "That's why I asked." (friend) apologizes, properly, and asks (subject) to tell (friend.him/her) every food to keep separate. They write the list on bark together.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only
